approach: File formats first, then a decompilation of the PS2 executable (built with CodeWarrior) and a native PC port running the player's own copy of the game
notes: Works on the PS2 release (a separate Xbox 360 recomp exists: rbxrootx/samurai_warriors_2_empires_recomp). Data containers, nested packs, all 16,027 textures (PNG), the 105 music tracks (WAV) and the 21 movies (MKV, stereo and Dolby Digital 5.1) are decoded and documented. Next: 3D models and battlefields, then the code. No game files in the repository.
